summary: Frontend-only review: settings and basic flow were exercised, but the clean eight-board transition could not be completed because the persisted active match rehydrated on each preview session. Code review found requirement regressions in crossover status and rules copy.
action_items: Remove the stale final-set board-4 CROSSOVER NEXT indicator from SeriesStatus; rotation is set-only.
Update the ICF rules modal rotation text, which still says doubles rotate after every board.
Re-run the eight-board set transition from a guaranteed cleared AsyncStorage state.
critical_code_review_comments: SeriesStatus still computes and renders crossover when currentSet === setsTotal and board === 4, contradicting the clarified set-only rotation requirement.
Rules modal copy says 'Doubles rotate all four seats clockwise after every board', contradicting implemented set-only rotation and user requirements.
Preview persistence makes repeated mobile regression runs rehydrate an active match, so clean-state testing requires an explicit reset before every run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667, series settings showed only Single/Best of 3/Best of 5, 8 boards, and set-only rotation; rules modal opened/closed; setup-to-toss-to-active worked. Existing AsyncStorage match rehydrated into SET 2, Board 3 after prior runs and prevented a clean transition assertion.
rca_of_issue: The stale crossover is still present in SeriesStatus's `crossover` expression and the rules text is hardcoded with per-board rotation. The incomplete transition test was caused by persisted carrom-match state, not an observed scoring failure.
